body.statement:
Let \(p\) be a nonzero, nonconstant homogeneous polynomial on \(\operatorname{Sym}_{2}(\mathbb R)\).  If for some \(c_2>0\) its trace-pairing symmetric gradient \(G_p\) satisfies
\[
 2\operatorname{tr}\{(G_p(Y)Y)^2\}=c_2p(Y)^2
\]
identically, then there are a line \(W1\subset\mathbb R^2\), integers \(j,k\geq0\) with \(j+k>0\), and \(\rho\neq0\) such that
\[
 p(Y)=\rho\det(C1YC1^{\top})^j\det(Y)^k,
\]
where \(C1\) is any full-row-rank basis of \(W1\).  When \(j>0\), the line \(W1\) is unique.
